name: Let's Play Blind Har Chaal Ek Dhokha
original_name: Let's Play Blind Har Chaal Ek Dhokha
overview: Let's Play Blind is set in the flashy and risky world of gambling. Three rich friends-Mohini, Neeta and Shanaya-play not just for money but for power and control. Things change when Mohak and Kavya join the game with a hidden plan.
